name: Report B, Block A peak velocity pressures (Report B spreadsheet)
description: Town site, vb,map 23.5 m/s, A = 43 m, z = 17.66 m, orientation -10°. The spreadsheet's cdir, ce, ce,T and hdis are entered by hand; qp is compared.

reference.source: Report B spreadsheet, sheet Block A, rows 3-22
reference.gap: The spreadsheet uses ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ (EN recommended value); the UK NA.2.18 value is 1.226, so the engine's qp is 1.226/1.25 = 0.9808 of the spreadsheet's. The spreadsheet also takes hdis = 0.6·have = 10.2 m where A.15 gives min(0.8·have, 0.6·h) = 10.6 m, and reads cdir at the tabulated direction nearest the normal rather than the maximum within ±45° (e.g. N 0.91 against 0.895); both are entered as printed here. Its cpe values are fixed (E = -0.6) rather than interpolated in h/d, and are not compared.
